item.title: Two Million Canary Requests Expose Leaks Across AI Supply Chain
item.description:
Dragos chief research officer HD Moore sent nearly two million canary-token requests to multiple AI providers and found at least three were breached, with attackers using stolen keys to make tens of thousands of cloud API calls. The study also shows reseller chains leaking data, with private URLs from requests marked zero data retention still being scraped days later.

原文标题：200 万条请求暴露 AI 供应链隐私漏洞

Why it matters：以大规模实测数据揭示 AI 服务链的密钥窃取与隐私承诺失效，对企业选型与部署决策有直接参考价值。

item.title: OpenAI Cuts Chain-of-Thought Extraction Rate to 0.2% with Anti-Distillation Defenses
item.description:
OpenAI unveiled multi-layered defenses against adversarial distillation, cutting protected chain-of-thought extraction on GPT-6.2 Astra from 54.0% to 0.2% for prior requests and from 22.9% to 0.9% for current ones. The measures combine adversarial training, input/output classifiers and API-level reasoning isolation, backed by weekly enforcement against thousands to tens of thousands of violating accounts.

原文标题：OpenAI 反蒸馏防护将思考链提取率降至 0.2%

Why it matters：首次系统披露前沿模型推理链防提取的量化效果与工程手段，对模型安全与 API 设计有直接参考价值。

item.title: AWS Quick Adds Multi-Agent Orchestration and Visual Flow Builder
item.description:
AWS released updates to its AI workspace Quick, letting users build business flows that orchestrate agents, skills and tools directly through conversation, with new deterministic steps for consistency and verifiability. Multi-agent orchestration now runs several specialized agents in parallel on a single prompt and merges their findings, while the web app keeps work running after the tab is closed.

原文标题：AWS Quick 升级多智能体协同与可视化流程编排

Why it matters：企业级 AI 工作空间开始把流程编排与多智能体协同产品化，值得关注智能体落地形态的读者一读。

item.title: Anthropic Researcher Predicts AI to Surpass Top Experts by Late 2027
item.description:
Anthropic technical staff member Tao Lin predicts that by late 2027 AI will match or surpass top human experts in nearly all domains, including programming and filmmaking, and warns that almost everyone could face permanent job loss and depend on government support. He nonetheless notes that mass unemployment by 2027 is highly unlikely given the slow pace of robotics deployment, which is required to displace physical-economy work.

原文标题：Anthropic 研究员预测 2027 年底 AI 超越顶尖专家

Why it matters：来自前沿实验室研究员的激进时间线预测，涉及就业冲击与机器人瓶颈，具备讨论价值但缺乏可验证技术增量。

item.title: Partial Code Understanding Is Normal in Large Projects and for AI Agents
item.description:
Sean Goedecke argues that in large software projects, programmers understanding only the code they own is normal and is the best achievable state. Bao Yu extends this to AI agents: they too can never fully understand a codebase in one session, so quality must be backstopped by automated tests, code review, and having agents supply screenshot evidence.

原文标题：大型项目中部分理解代码是常态，Agent 亦然

Why it matters：将人类在大型代码库中的部分理解常态迁移到 Agent 工程实践，给出测试兜底与截图取证等可操作的质量保障思路。

item.title: Claude Assists in Proving Riemann Hypothesis After 167 Years
item.description:
Anthropic mathematician Alpöge and Claude have reportedly proved the Riemann hypothesis, a problem unsolved for 167 years, completing the work in roughly six weeks and formalizing the full argument as machine-checkable code. Claude contributed a key step in advanced areas Alpöge admits he had not mastered, an idea he says will make fellow mathematicians 'fall out of their chairs.' The result directly echoes Peter Thiel's 2024 prediction that AI would crack olympiad-level math within 3-5 years, leaving math people worse off than word people.

原文标题：Claude 协助证明黎曼猜想 数学界 167 年难题告破

Why it matters：若属实，这是 AI 首次参与解决数学界最著名的未解难题，是前沿模型能力的里程碑事件。

Rohan Paul (@rohanpaul_ai) · llm · signal 88/100

item.title: AWS Launches Distributed KV Caching to Cut LLM Inference Costs
item.description:
AWS introduced distributed KV caching built on Amazon ElastiCache, adding a shared cache tier beside GPU fleets so any server can reuse KV state for days across sessions, routing shifts and failures. AWS claims the approach cuts self-hosted LLM inference costs by up to 40% and time to first token by up to 80%, directly addressing redundant prefill work in long-context agents.

原文标题：AWS 推出分布式 KV 缓存 推理成本降 40%

Why it matters：针对自托管大模型长上下文重复预填充这一真实痛点，给出可量化的降本与降延迟方案，对推理基础设施读者有直接参考价值。

item.title: Nvidia Sheds $2.73 Trillion as Nasdaq Posts Worst Week Since 2020
item.description:
Nvidia fell another 14% on Friday, extending a roughly 47% drawdown from its October peak and wiping out more than $2.73 trillion in market value, larger than all of Amazon. The selloff was triggered by CEO Jensen Huang's resignation amid a scandal, compounded by doubts over AI valuations and capex returns, sending the Nasdaq down 10% for its worst week since March 2020.

原文标题：英伟达市值蒸发 2.73 万亿美元 纳斯达克创疫情后最差单周

Why it matters：AI 算力龙头遭遇历史级回撤，是判断 AI 产业估值与资本周期的重要信号。

item.title: OpenAI Releases MedChemBench to Gauge AI Drug Discovery Skills
item.description:
OpenAI has released MedChemBench, a 99-question benchmark drawn from 117 papers and patents to evaluate model reasoning in medicinal chemistry. GPT-6.2 Astra scores 84.5% usable at the xhigh reasoning tier, reaching 95.4% on molecular structure reconstruction but only about half correct on compound selection and numerical property prediction. OpenAI cautions the results do not prove models can discover new drugs, only map capability boundaries.

原文标题：OpenAI 发布 MedChemBench 药物化学基准

Why it matters：OpenAI 首个面向药物化学推理的公开基准，分项数据清晰揭示模型在结构重建与性质预测间的巨大落差。

item.title: Intel Reveals High Failure Rates in Early DDR5 Validation
item.description:
Intel disclosed behind-the-scenes details of early DDR5 development, noting that prototype DRAM modules often failed to boot on first insertion and required repeated joint debugging with Samsung, SK Hynix, Micron and JEDEC. DDR5 adds PMIC, SPD hub and clock drivers plus tighter voltage margins, making validation far more complex than DDR4. Intel used thousands of processors for testing and noted client platform DRAM die density rose from 16Gb to 32Gb.

原文标题：英特尔披露 DDR5 早期验证失败率极高

Why it matters：揭示 DDR5 验证工程细节与产业链协同机制，对理解内存与平台兼容性有参考价值。

item.title: Anthropic Mathematician Claims Claude Helped Prove Riemann Hypothesis
item.description:
Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge claims he and Claude discovered a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis and its generalized form, releasing roughly 17 million lines of Lean formalization while withholding a 250,000-page written proof. Terence Tao says the argument appears to draw on the Langlands program and arithmetic geometry, and that the community needs time to verify it; preliminary checks confirm the formalized statement is indeed GRH, though Lean kernel soundness remains a theoretical risk.

原文标题：Anthropic 数学家称 Claude 辅助证明黎曼猜想

Why it matters：若属实将是 AI 辅助数学的里程碑事件，且涉及形式化验证可信度这一关键争议。

item.title: Apollo and Goldman Price $44B GPU Financing for SpaceX
item.description:
Apollo Global Management and Goldman Sachs have priced roughly $44 billion in senior and subordinated notes to fund SpaceX's purchase of next-generation Nvidia Vera Rubin GPUs and related equipment, marking the largest GPU financing deal to date. Strong investor demand drove an oversubscribed and upsized transaction, with hardware delivery expected in the first half of 2027 when the lease arrangement takes effect.

原文标题：阿波罗与高盛完成 440 亿美元 GPU 融资定价

Why it matters：这是迄今规模最大的 GPU 融资交易，直接反映前沿算力资本化与英伟达下一代芯片需求的量级。

item.title: Google Duplex Evolves into Gemini-Powered Business Calling

Google has integrated its 2018 Duplex phone-conversation technology into Tasks in Gemini, letting the AI call local businesses on users' behalf to complete reservations and bookings. The move marks Duplex's evolution from a standalone demo into background infrastructure powering Gemini's agentic task capabilities.

Why it matters：Duplex 从独立系统并入 Gemini 智能体，是语音代理落地真实任务的关键产品化节点。

item.title: US Regulators Cleared 879,868 Nvidia and AMD AI Chips for China
item.description:
House Foreign Affairs Committee files show Nvidia and AMD sought licenses for over 3.4 million H200 and MI325X chips for Chinese customers including Alibaba and Tencent; by May the Bureau of Industry and Security had approved roughly 879,868, about one in four, with every approved application rated low diversion risk. Approved buyers reportedly include firms the Pentagon flags as military-linked, underscoring tension between export-control enforcement and national-security scrutiny.

原文标题：美监管机构批准 87.9 万枚英伟达 AMD 芯片对华出口

Why it matters：这是迄今最具体的对华 AI 芯片出口许可数据，直接关系算力供给与管制走向。

item.title: Anonymous Model Gestalt Tops Design Benchmark With 1931 Elo
item.description:
Contra Labs released its Frontier Design Benchmark, where an anonymous stealth model codenamed Gestalt topped the leaderboard with a 1931 Elo rating and 90% win rate, beating the human designer reference (1739) as well as Claude Fable 5.2 and GPT-6.1 Sol. The benchmark drew on 33 real commercial design tasks and 4,311 blind votes from 35 professional designers across five rounds; Gestalt also scored near-human on quality rubrics and AI-slop detection, though its team and architecture remain undisclosed.

原文标题：匿名模型 Gestalt 登顶设计盲测 Elo 达 1931

Why it matters：首个以真实商业设计委托为任务的盲测榜单出现匿名黑马，且评分超越人类参考，值得关注其后续身份揭晓。

item.title: HeyGen Releases Decision 1 Model That Outputs Probabilities for Video
item.description:
HeyGen has launched Decision 1, a model that generates no text at all: it accepts text, image, video or audio input, answers up to 400 questions, and returns a probability per question that code can act on directly. It is now available through the AI/ML API platform, with a demo scoring 8 out of 8 on gesture and emotion recognition at roughly $0.0027 per run.

原文标题：HeyGen 发布 Decision 1 视频概率判定模型

Why it matters：视频理解从生成文本转向输出可编程概率，为自动化决策类应用提供了新的接口范式。

item.title: AWS Adds Managed Cluster Extensions to SageMaker HyperPod Slurm
item.description:
AWS introduced managed cluster extensions for Slurm clusters in Amazon SageMaker HyperPod, starting with observability and user management. The feature brings node-level software and settings under declarative API or console control, with AWS validating changes and continuously maintaining the desired state, extending the 2026 roadmap of API-driven configuration, AMI-based setup, continuous provisioning, automatic topology management and deep health checks.

原文标题：亚马逊 SageMaker HyperPod 推出 Slurm 托管集群扩展

Why it matters：面向大模型训练基础设施的配置漂移治理更新，对运维 Slurm 集群的团队有直接参考价值。

item.title: SEC Probes Nvidia Accounting as Shares Plunge 14 Percent
item.description:
The FT reports that US securities regulators are examining Nvidia, expanding a civil review of whether its disclosures misled investors into an accounting probe. Shares fell 14% in one session, erasing roughly $491B in market cap. A focal point is Nvidia's shift from billing-location to customer-headquarters revenue reporting shortly after blocklisting Megaspeed in June 2025, which moved most of $10.2B in Singapore-billed revenue into the US line.

原文标题：美 SEC 调查英伟达会计问题 市值单日蒸发 4910 亿美元

Why it matters：监管调查叠加千亿美元级市值蒸发，直接冲击 AI 算力龙头的财务可信度与收入地域口径。

item.title: OpenAI Opens ChatGPT Spaces Collaboration to Plus Subscribers

OpenAI has extended ChatGPT Spaces, its multiplayer collaboration workspace, from Pro, Business and Enterprise tiers down to the $20/month Plus plan, enabling shared documents, agent-oriented Pages and Scheduled Tasks co-editing. Launched at the September 2026 Dev Day, the rollout is staged for users 18 and older, while free users still cannot open shared content.

item.title: AWS Launches SageMaker HyperPod Global Inference Gateway
item.description:
AWS introduced the SageMaker HyperPod Global Inference Gateway, extending its GPU-aware routing from a single cluster to a single managed endpoint spanning multiple clusters and Regions. The gateway selects clusters using real-time signals such as KV cache utilization and queue depth, carries requests over the AWS backbone, and provides automatic failover with SigV4 and IAM authentication. It targets capacity waste when one cluster queues requests while GPUs elsewhere sit idle.

原文标题：AWS 推出 SageMaker 跨区全局推理网关

Why it matters：面向大模型推理的跨区容量调度能力更新，对使用 HyperPod 的团队有直接工程价值。

item.title: IETF Draft Proposes Merkle Tree Certificates to Cut Post-Quantum Overhead
item.description:
The IETF PLANTS working group published version 08 of the Merkle Tree Certificates draft, co-authored by Google, Apple, Cloudflare and Geomys. The design embeds Certificate Transparency-style public logging directly into X.509 certificates, cutting logging overhead for short-lived certificates and large post-quantum signatures while preserving security properties comparable to existing CT, with an optional signature-omission optimization.

原文标题：IETF 提出 Merkle 树证书 降低后量子签名开销

Why it matters：主流浏览器与云厂商联合推进的 PKI 底层标准演进，直接影响后量子时代 TLS 证书体系的部署成本。

item.description:
Nace AI 发布 Drex Router，基于 Gemma 构建的 12B 模型读取提示词与候选模型列表，在 57 至 87 毫秒内返回模型选择、每个候选的概率及简短理由。在 1400 道通用知识考题测试中准确率 87.6%，每千题成本 0.10 美元，对比 Jev Router 的 86.4% 与 1.09 美元。

item.title: Meta 因 AI 数据中心排放激增重估 2030 净零目标
item.description:
Meta 在 2026 年可持续发展报告中首次承认，正重新评估 2030 年实现净零排放的时间表与阶段性目标，原因是 AI 基础设施需求增长远超预期，导致其温室气体排放增幅创下纪录并超过所有大型科技同行。公司称长期愿景未变，但运营环境已发生实质变化。

Why it matters：这是 AI 算力扩张与气候承诺正面冲突的标志性事件，头部厂商首次公开松动净零时间表，对理解 AI 基础设施成本具有行业风向意义。
